headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals took down the Detroit Tigers 3-2 in a thrilling victory, with Hao-Yu Lee leading the offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The Washington Nationals secured a crucial win over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense and Foster Griffin earning the win. The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels 9-2, with Robbie Ray earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Cody Bellinger (New York Yankees), Shea Langeliers (Athletics), Mike Paredes (Minnesota Twins), Josh Jung (Texas Rangers), Spencer Arrighetti (Houston Astros), Juan Soto (New York Mets), Shawn Armstrong (Cleveland Guardians), and Tanner Banks (Philadelphia Phillies).

The Washington Nationals made a significant trade, acquiring Connelly Early from the Boston Red Sox in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead. The Philadelphia Phillies also made a trade, acquiring CF Kameron Misner from the Kansas City Royals for cash. Additionally, the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres for Future Considerations, while the Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals took down the Detroit Tigers 3-2, securing a crucial win. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Foster Griffin earned the win, while Clayton Beeter secured the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Dominate Angels in 9-2 Rout**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a convincing 9-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels, with Robbie Ray earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease. Cease pitched 9.0 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing just 1 hit.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Close Match**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0 in a low-scoring game. Impact performances came from Parker Messick and Drew Rasmussen on the mound, while Chandler Simpson had a notable outing at the plate.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 10-7**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Nationals included James Wood, Dylan Crews, CJ Abrams, and Connelly Early.

top_news.title: **Yankees Place Cody Bellinger on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cody Bellinger, the left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. This move is effective immediately.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Curtis Mead in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead.
